The climate in Kos

Kos is about 11 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 30°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 11°C. Around 650 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in January (about 166 mm). The highest temperature in Kos in 2015–2024 was 37°C (13 June 2024) and the lowest 2°C (8 January 2015).

Best time to visit Kos

The most pleasant weather in Kos is usually in May, June, September and October: average highs are between 23°C and 28°C, with up to 4 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
